text:
Alice Nguyen: Quick ask 1 PR #4683 modifies model-ops/CODEOWNERS to add the team alias @oncall-models. Wed like this merged before tomorrow's 09:00 UTC deploy. Can someone confirm who is allowed to approve a CODEOWNERS change that points to an empty team alias?

Ben Patel: Short answer: if the alias is empty, it still becomes an owner reference. Policy-wise, changes to CODEOWNERS are allowed by any existing owner for that path, but adding a team alias that introduces a new approval boundary usually requires an eng-platform +1.

Carla M: @Alice can you paste the exact diff? if it's purely a single-line add it's lower risk; adding new paths or modifying deploy hooks ups the review bar.

Alice Nguyen: Diff below 
```
# model-ops
model-ops/ @oncall-models
```
Also added model-ops/README.md documenting rotation. No k8s or deploy scripts changed.

Dave R: The tricky bit: an empty alias means no one will be auto-requested for reviews until we populate it. We normally avoid landing owner aliases that have zero members. If you need to land it now, we can grant an exception but we should record the justification.

Eve (security): From sec: no direct security risk here since no infra hooks changed. Recommend documenting who will be responsible to populate the alias and an audit note. Happy to waive extra sign-off for this specific PR. :+1:

Alice Nguyen: We want to add the alias now and fill members tomorrow. Deploy ETA is 09:00 UTC. Can eng-platform approve a temporary exception so this can land? I added an exceptions note in the PR describing the intended members and rotation. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4683

Ben Patel: Process we follow: 1) Add an exceptions section in the PR describing the reason and the planned member additions, 2) Tag eng-platform and infra leads in the PR, 3) Get at least one eng-platform +1. If you do that I can +1 before I sign off tomorrow.

Carla M: I can +1 now provided you add the exceptions note and a link to the oncall rotation doc in the README. Also leave a follow-up task to populate the alias within 24h.

infra-bot: CI: build/12877 passed, unit tests: 416 passed, integration flaky skipped: 6. :white_check_mark:

Dave R: OK sounds reasonable. @Ben Patel and @Carla M have indicated verbal +1s here. @eng-platform please record the exception in our approvals tracker and we can merge after another quick CI pass (I will monitor at 08:30 UTC).

Alice Nguyen: Thanks all 1 added the exceptions section, linked rotation doc, and created a follow-up issue to populate the alias. Merging once the scheduled CI job completes.

Ben Patel: Thanks, :shipit:
